utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: I cannot really confirm that. I see that it's a settled area and I see that there are streets running through those settlements. Now, what communications trenches you are referring to, I really can't tell.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Can you recognise, can you see in the lower left-hand corner, can you recognise a cemetery there?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: This is indeed a cemetery.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And the barren area above, is that the Grdonj hill, the Grdonj Brdo, and then there is a relay facility on top of the hill?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: If this is the cemetery next to the Podhrastovi hospital then to the north of it we do indeed see the Grdonj Brdo. So I don't know if this is that cemetery or another cemetery. So there is this cemetery but there is another one on Grlica Brdo, both of these cemeteries are in the same area. So if what you're showing me here is next to the Podhrastovi hospital, then north of it is indeed Grdonj Brdo.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, can you confirm that the top of the hill, of this hill, Grdonj Brdo, and the slopes, the southern slopes, facing the city, that they were under the control of the BH army?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: The Grdonj Brdo was under BH army control for about two --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I don't think the witness has confirmed Grdonj from this map or this photo image.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now see the image as we saw it originally? Can the general -- so that the general can see Spicasta Stijena.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this Spicasta Stijena next to Grdonj Brdo?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, can you show me which one?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, the only Stijena, or rock, that you can see in this image.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I don't see any rock.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, to the east of Grdonj Brdo, is that Spicasta Stijena, or Peaked Rock?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I can't really tell you by looking at this map. I know where Spicasta Stijena is, but I cannot really recognise it on this map.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we then have 65 ter 0748, please. I believe that all the participants in the courtroom are familiar with this landscape and that the Trial Chamber is also familiar with it. 65 ter 07048.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: That is a portion, a section, of the map of the Chief of Staff of the 1st Corps which office you held or which post you were at for a while.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That's Exhibit P1058, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now blow up the boundary, the border, between the central part and the top part. Could we just blow up the portion above the number 152.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: General, can you now see Grdonj Brdo, elevation 96; and then Hladivode, and so on? Can you see it now?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, yes, now I can see it clearly.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: This is a map that was produced by your corps, and here we see the 105th Brigade, the 1st Mountain Battalion, the 2nd Mountain Battalion, mortar units, and then at the very top of Grdonj Brdo and its southern slopes, they are under BH army control; correct?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct, but I have to say that these are not mortar units deployed there. These are weapons. That's what this symbol indicates. This is one single artillery piece. If it were to denote mortars, then it would be a circular distribution of weapons. So these are artillery pieces, but it is correct this is the area of responsibility, or rather, the area that was under the control of the BH army and that stretched to the south of Grdonj Brdo and Hladivode that we can see on the map to the east.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Are the lines rather close one to the other here near Grdonj Brdo, whereas in other areas they're more far apart?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please now take a look at the area below 105bbr. There is a small flag symbol. Is that the area between the Kljuc factory and the large park?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, yes, I think so and I think I marked that area. So yes, that's probably that location. Just a minute, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you see the park right next to it and then further towards Kosevo?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I can see it. That's exactly the spot. Maybe 50 or 100 metres up or down. We can't be absolutely precise because it's just a map, but yes that's the general area.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you confirm that these triangular flags are battalion commands?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, a triangle map indicates a command post of a battalion or an artillery battalion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And we see also that there is the 4th Battalion there, mountain battalion. Can you see that the 115th Brigade is close, or rather --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: -- the 152nd, do you see that area, that's -- Ive asked you about it earlier?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, and you said that it was close to the cathedral on Vase Miskina Street, the 152nd Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we now go a little bit more to the west on this map -- or rather, just a moment, please. General, can you see that above the military hospital we can see a howitzer on the hospital?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, this is a tactical symbol for a gun or a cannon, and a tactical symbol for a machine-gun.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Will you please mark it with a circle and could the usher please assist us with electronic pen.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you please put a number 1 there and then also mark the military hospital compound and put a number 2 there.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you see below it the military hospital compound?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, if this is what it is I think so, but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we now admit this section of the map into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And, Witness, would you please initial this and put a date and also --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not hear the last part of the question.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, these are mortars and I believe they belonged to the 115th Mountain Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you please put your initials and the date in the right-hand bottom corner.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, because you overlapped, the interpreters didn't hear the last part of your question. Could you tell us what it was and make -- get a confirmation from the witness.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I believe that I asked whether these were mortars of the 115th Brigade on the hill-sides of Trebevic and the witness confirmed that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Correct?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct, these are mortars.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can I ask you then, above the indication where the 152nd Brigade was at Vasin Han, was one of those weapons a cannon, one is a mortar, and one a howitzer?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes. One of them is a recoilless gun, one of them is an anti-aircraft gun, and one of those weapons is a mortar.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And to the east next to the number 1bb there is a mortar and a [indiscernible]. What's that?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, that's an anti-aircraft gun, a machine-gun.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The so-called PAM, P-A-M. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Now could we admit this, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D1381, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just for planning purposes, how much more would you have?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, I don't know how much time the Prosecution will need for its re-direct, but would it be possible to also get some extra time tomorrow with this witness because we have a number of documents that were signed by this witness that I would like to show him. I will make a selection. I won't use every single document, but this man was a Chief of Staff for a period of almost a year.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Let us proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we now move to the western part of this map of the town. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you mark, put a number 1 at Velesici. Can you see the bus terminal and then Pofalici and then Velesici?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I can see it now.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Put a number 1 to mark Velesici, number 2 at the railway station.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Number 3 for Vrbanja bridge, can you see it? You can see Grbavica; right?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, yes, I can but I don't know which of these bridges would be the right one. I don't want to make a mistake. I believe that this is it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you now please look at the deployments of the 101st Brigade at Hrasno and Hrasno Brdo and could you explain what we see there.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: What we can see there is that there is a command post of the 105th and -- 101st and 143rd Brigade there at the same location. But I have to add that these units and these -- this equipment was not within the area of responsibility of the 1st Corps in the town itself while I was the Chief of Staff. This is the situation as it was after 1994 when it was possible to move through the tunnel, to get in and out of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, they were called something else but they were in the same area of responsibility, weren't they?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, they had different names there, but I don't know what this 143rd unit is, for instance. I don't know what that unit was.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we see mortars there and anti-aircraft weapons? Can you tell us what weapons we can see there, what symbols?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: To the south, this is an anti-aircraft machine-gun.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: That's number 4; right? Put a number 4 there, please.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: South-east from the brigade command there are mortars and south-east from the brigade, the command post of the brigade, we have mortars. I'll put a number 5 there. And I think I can't see any other equipment and hardware there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you please initial this and date it on the left-hand side near Vrace.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to tender this, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D1382, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we get the next westerly section of the town, please. A bit back, a bit more to the east, to the east, please. Thank you. This is fine.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we see Halilovici here and was there a barrack there?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: There was a barrack, a JNA barrack, in Halilovici. It was a motorised battalion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we see the television building here and the radio -- the radio television building, the main building? We can see Otoka and then Dzemala Bijedica Street and then we get to Halilovici.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I know where all those buildings are but I just have to find my bearings on this map. Well, if this is the television complex, compound, where I'm pointing with my pen. Can you see it? Novi Grad municipality and the television compound. I think that's the area here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, would you use the pen, please.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I don't know if this is that facility.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Now, do you agree that the entire area beyond the television compound is an industrial area, that the Zica factory is there, that Jastreb factory is there?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, that is true, it was an industrial area which stretched from Otoka all the way to Alipasin Most, Alipasin Bridge. In other words, this was a stretch -- an area stretching east-west and that whole area was an industrial zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you please then draw a line and connect Otok -- from Otok towards the north towards Dzemala Bijedica Street and the one-time Drinska Street.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: The interpreter could not hear the witness because he was not speaking into the microphone.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you please date and initial this.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now we are entering the zone of the 2nd or later 102nd Brigade, or rather, the 3rd Brigade that later became 102nd?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I wasn't listening to what you were saying because I was trying to mark this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: General, did you say something while making those markings? The interpreters couldn't hear you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] While I was putting these markings I was -- I didn't say anything.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Yes, Mr. Karadzic. We'll admit this separately.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D1383, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we now move further west, please. And then can we move it up a bit. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now can we see Nedzarici here that was under the VRS control -- VRS army control and then we see the 155th and the 1st, 3rd, and 5th Brigades that are in the neighbourhood. In other words, Dobrinja, Alipasino Polje, and then Stupsko Brdo settlements; correct?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: You have all this information on the map itself and I think this is rather reliable or accurate.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Are these markings for mortars to the north of Vidikovac or Vlakovac or whatever the name may be towards the upper edge?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, two mortars.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Since we haven't marked anything, can we lift the map to see all of Dobrinja. Mojmilo, we see a marking for a mortar or what is the other one? Is it for an anti-aircraft gun? Do you see the separation line now in Dobrinja, red and blue, and at Mojmilo Hill we have a few - what are they?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not hear the answer.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So machine-guns, anti-aircraft and then the triangle is the command post of some battalion?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: The 1st Battalion; that's written there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And in Dobrinja itself there is the command post of the 155th, formerly the 5th Brigade and a few command posts of battalions, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd, and a few mortars; right?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you please sign this as well and put the date.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Did he mark anything? I don't think so. Could you take a look at the transcript, page 101, line 4. You followed-up with some questions. Please check whether we missed anything. His answer was not interpreted, what at Mojmilo hill, red and blue.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: May I ask you to mark on Mojmilo hill the command post of the 1st Battalion and then the mortar and then these three PAMs. Perhaps there's more of them but three are marked.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And then this straight line goes to the north and that is the zone, or rather, it is a line where -- no, it's actually a battalion line; right?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: A battalion line, thank you. Then here in Dobrinja, can you put a circle around the command post and -- of the brigade I mean and the command posts of the battalions.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We see this for ourselves, don't we? We can see the mortars?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Only one battalion command post is marked here and three battalions are marked, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd. And there is no number at this command post that is marked here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Does that mean that that is the disposition of the battalions, that they don't have a command post marked?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes. This one was to the north of Dobrinja and these two were south-east.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you now put the date and your initials?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you know that in Dobrinja and Omladinskih Radnih Brigada Street there was a prison? I believe that it was in the basement of the post office and the bank.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: This is the first time I hear of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can this section be admitted.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D1384, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have the south, that is to say to scroll the map up significantly. And then a bit to the west. And now could you lower it a bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this Igman, what you see now?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we lower the map now. A bit more, please. Thank you. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What we see is the area of responsibility of the 4th, formerly, and then the 104th. Is this Hrasnica?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this one command post of this brigade in Sokolovic Kolonija?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: According to the marking, yes, but it's not in the town of Hrasnica where it was before.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How do you explain that? There is nothing for the 104th. Is this the 14th Division so the commander was not -- was not really involved in this?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Commanders had to be involved in all matters. Why nothing was marked -- well, probably he did not provide the corps command with information. I don't know when this map was made. The command probably did not have this information and that's why it was not marked.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. We are not going to mark anything here because we cannot see any original markings.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at the upper left-hand corner and see who drafted the map and signed it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think we also have a name on the bottom right part. Bottom, bottom right part. Down. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you know this gentleman, Rizvo Pleh, then-Chief of Staff, and his signature?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I know him personally.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. So it is an authentic map, although it is not complete in view of the 14th Division?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Just a moment, please. Could we just see the upper left-hand corner. Could we see what unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The 12th Division.

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: According to what I see now, I don't know whether at the time the 104th was within the 12th Division.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It was within the 14th; right?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, according to the information on the map, as I have seen it just now, the 104th was not within this 12th Division. And that is why that information is not contained, the information pertaining to that brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you, General.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have 1D3703.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you familiar with this area towards Spicasta Stijena and these are trenches of the Army of Bosnia-Herzegovina?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: I know the area in its natural environment, but if you just look at this it can be anywhere.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you know that the trenches were there facing each other?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: I know that the trenches were only 50 metres apart in some areas, but I do not know whether this is actually that terrain. I cannot see it on the basis of this map.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Then I'm not going to torment you with this any longer.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 3701, can we have that document, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you know the name Meho Podrug?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: No, I don't know who the man is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You don't know where this monument is then?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: No. Now I see it for the first time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Then we're not going to deal with it. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 1D913, can we have that, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that this is a record of an interview of Vlatko Vukovic, son of Tihomir, on the 30th of March, 1993?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: On the basis of what is written here, that's that record but I'm not familiar with the content or with the person that gave this statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we move on to the second page.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you see this here: "From the beginning of the war ..." This is a statement of this person, the Kosevo Hospital was secured by --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note, we cannot find it in either language.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you look at this paragraph and it says that Juka's wolves were where the pharmacy was. Are you familiar with this deployment of these units led by Juka and the Green Berets?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: While these units existed I was not in Sarajevo. So as for all of Juka's units that he had in town, that is, we established a single unit, the 2nd Independent Battalion. This is the first time I see this. I don't know any one of these units. That was probably in the initial period of the war.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Probably this was not asked. Did you know that Kosevo Hospital was secured by the Green Berets?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't know, really. First of all, that unit did not exist in our corps. So initially that unit was not within the corps, that is to say the unit of the Green Berets did not exist. So whether someone was a member of the Green Berets, that is something I really don't know about or how many such people there were.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. What is the current name of the former JNA street? Is it called the Green Berets Street?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: I think so. I think so. I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Does that mean then that they were outside of the control of the 1st Corps, these Green Berets?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: Well, these units I think at the time when I was Chief of Staff, they did not exist at all, that is to say -- well, rumour had it that they existed before the 1st Corps was established. But as a unit, I never heard of their existence and I did not know that there was a unit outside the corps that was called the Green Berets. I did know of the name, namely, that some units were formed from the ranks of the Green Berets. That's the point. I really don't know anything about these units.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Except for them being incorporated in the 1st Corps?

utterances.speaker: ASIM DZAMBASOVIC
utterances.text: No, no. Those who used to be in those units, depending on who was where, were transferred to the units that were established by the 1st Corps, as was the case with Juka's units. So he had his bases throughout town. And then out of all of these bases and out of all of these units we barely managed to establish an independent battalion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, it's time for us to rise for today. I think we have given you sufficient time to cover your case which was not covered by the examination-in-chief. Do you still need more time?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If the Defence and the Prosecution could share a session tomorrow, I think that we would manage to tender the documents that were either written by the witness or read by the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can you tell us how much you would need for your re-direct examination?

utterances.speaker: MS. GUSTAFSON
utterances.text: At this point about five minutes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You will have three-quarters of an hour, up to three-quarters of an hour tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll continue tomorrow, General. In the meantime probably you are aware of it but you are not supposed to discuss with anybody about your evidence. Do you understand that, General?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. 9.00, tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
